company.name: STRABL
company.shortDescription: Payments & Checkout Solution - Enabling "Zero Pay, One Click & Biometric Checkouts"
company.description:
STRABL is a Payments & Checkout solution, providing a SaaS based solution that integrates with E-Commerce merchants and businesses that offer digital payments enabling them with  purchasing options like "Try Before You Buy, Pay Later and Zero Pay Checkout".
STRABL enhances the customer journey experience through it's world's fastest checkout system and integrated logistics support.
While providing one-stop multiple payment method integration to save costs & reduce complexities.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,894,300 to $4,894,300, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
